notes: Adds a one-click Codex completion-Hook review action under Resource Manager → Agent access, using Codex's current Hook key and hash.
Re-checks the Hook immediately before trust writes, refuses mismatched commands or changed hashes, and verifies trusted-and-enabled state after the write.
Includes a read-only-by-default diagnostic script with an explicit --apply mode for temporary recovery.
Makes the DingDong mascot shake briefly when a new clipboard copy is detected.
